scene: Your ukulele song summons three sky transports to the village edge.
picture: Flat side view along wooden planks. Far left, the racoon cook claps happily beside his cart. Left, an open-doored pink bullet train hums on a rail. Centre left, the broad Pacific Islander player holds his ukulele. Centre, a moored solar-sail junk floats. Right, a coiled green dragon maglev train waits on glowing tracks.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train idling with open doors on the left
a wooden junk with glowing solar sails moored at the centre dock
a green maglev dragon train waiting on glowing rails on the right
